q: The Koopman functor K maps a measure-preserving transformation f to:
opts: The phase space (X,μ) as a set
The unitary operator Uf: L²(X,μ)→L²(X,μ) given by Uf(φ) = φ∘f
The factor maps from (X,f) to other systems
exp: K: Meas.Dyn^{op} → Hilb sends (X,μ,f) ↦ (L²(X,μ), Uf). The Koopman operator is unitary (f preserves μ). This functor translates ergodic theory into spectral theory of unitary operators on Hilbert spaces.
